@router.post("/api/v1/escrow/{escrow_id}/release")
async def release_escrow_deposit(
    escrow_id: str,
    session_factory: async_sessionmaker = Depends(get_async_session_factory),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    async with session_factory() as session:
        async with session.begin():
            stmt = select(EscrowContract).where(
                EscrowContract.id == escrow_id,
                EscrowContract.buyer_id == current_user.id
            ).with_for_update()
            result = await session.execute(stmt)
            escrow = result.scalar_one_or_none()
            if not escrow:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Escrow contract not found or access denied")
            if escrow.status != EscrowStatus.FUNDED:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Escrow is not in funded state")
            escrow.status = EscrowStatus.RELEASED
            escrow.released_at = datetime.utcnow()
            seller_wallet = await session.get(Wallet, escrow.seller_wallet_id, with_for_update=True)
            seller_wallet.balance += escrow.locked_amount
            session.add(escrow)
            session.add(seller_wallet)
    return {"status": "funds_released", "escrow_id": escrow_id}
